milestones.description: Complete at least one new bed and at least one new toilet. Handwashing facilities are not required. Blueprints do not count.

After setup, produce at least 10000 joules of electricity, 20 kilograms of oxygen and 1000 kilocalories of food, established by native positive-production records rather than building counts or existing stock.
Complete at least one technology after setup.
Complete at least three technologies after setup, including at least one whose pinned native cost requires advanced research points.
Complete at least six technologies after setup, including at least two whose pinned native costs require advanced research points. No additional waiting-cycle requirement applies.
